title: Chapter 388 The Seventh Army
content:
Chapter 388 The Seventh Army

Of course, in terms of top combat power, it is still far behind Shanhai City.

After all, Shanhai City has 4 junior generals and one intermediate general.

After the military parade, Wang Shuo summoned all the commanders to the Transmission Hall to prepare for an accelerated training.

The first is the training of battle formations, and the second is the training of personal strength.

Three days later, when Wang Shuo was training with a group of generals, Zhao Bangde sent a message.

Notify Wang Shuo that he can set off for the Great Wall of Steel.

Wang Shuo suddenly opened his eyes, and this time he consumed more than 20 million energy crystals.

Wang Shuo has practiced the "Black Dragon Sutra" to the peak of the fourth level, and he may break through to the fifth level at any time.

The other generals are also about to reach their limits. If they want to break through the bottleneck, they need an opportunity, and this war is the best opportunity.

Half a day later, Wang Shuo and the main generals arrived at the Great Wall of Steel first.

At this time, the barrier outside has not completely disappeared.

The length of the Great Wall of Steel is 500 kilometers, with humans and undead each accounting for half.

In the temporary command center.

Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng sat at the top, followed by Sauron, Xie Xiaofeng and others, including Wang Shuo, a total of eight junior generals.

Top generals were not eligible to participate in this pre-war meeting.

With the last defense of Shanhai City, everyone had experience in coordinated operations.

Facing unknown enemies, although everyone was a little nervous, they were still calm.

Zhao Bangde had reorganized all the troops in Hedong County and Nanxuan Prefecture into ten armies.

A total of 1.5 million troops, of which 500,000 were in reserve.

Each general was responsible for commanding 150,000 people.

In addition to his own troops, Wang Shuo also controlled another 100,000 troops.

This 100,000-man army was mainly provided by the towns of Changping County, including the lords, who were all within the scope of conscription.

After issuing the combat order, Wang Shuo immediately summoned all the generals to his camp.

Among them are Lin Dabiao, Liu Zhiming, Wen Yifan, Zhang Yang, Zheng Zhongji, Fang Kai and others.

Each town only needs to send one general.

Therefore, female generals such as Bu Lanlan and Dongfang Ling were directly arranged by Wang Shuo in the reserve.

Their combat effectiveness is still inferior to the highest combat effectiveness of the territory.

Although Bu Lanlan is also a high-level general, she cannot beat her general Lin Dabiao in terms of strength.

Similarly, Dongfang Ling is much weaker than Fang Kai.

In this battle, Wang Shuo was still a little worried whether these forces outside the domain would turn against him at the critical period of the battle.

Therefore, he arranged several mayors outside the domain he knew by his side, so that if there was a situation of turning against him, he could suppress it as soon as possible.

But if these people are not used, it feels like some combat power is lost for no reason, which is not worth the loss.

Even if these people can consume some combat power of the opponent, it is also very good.

Wang Shuo, who had become a military commander, saw Fang Kai and others, and he did not have the slightest thought of making things difficult for him.

Perhaps, as long as he grew fast enough, those former enemies would not even be qualified to be opponents!

The unit Wang Shuo belonged to was called the Seventh Army.

There were 150,000 people in total, 50,000 of whom were in reserve.

As for the other nine armies, they were two county governors and the remaining seven generals.

There were four generals in Shanhai City, and two in Nanxuan Prefecture.

The remaining one was Xin Kun, the former mayor of Dongshi Town, who had always suppressed Wang Shuo.

He also raised his strength to the level of a general in these three months, and Zhao Bangde did not skimp and directly upgraded his town to a county town.

Wang Shuo could not help but sigh, this is not a cheat, he is eating shit upside down.
